title: LACP Configuration
description: Configure Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP) between switches.
scenario: Configure Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP) between switches.

concepts.title: LACP (802.3ad)
concepts.body: LACP is the open standard for link aggregation. Use "mode active" on both sides to negotiate.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface range FastEthernet0/1-2
SW1(config-if-range)# channel-group 1 mode active

concepts.title: Requirements
concepts.body: All member ports must have the same speed, duplex, VLAN, and trunk mode. Otherwise the channel fails.
concepts.code:
Same speed ✓
Same duplex ✓
Same VLAN ✓
Same trunk mode ✓

concepts.title: Load Balancing
concepts.body: EtherChannel load-balances traffic by source/destination MAC or IP. Default is src-dst MAC.
